renethack @VERSION@
====================

What this package holds, and under which terms. The files named here are in
this folder.

The game: the renethack client
------------------------------
The Godot extension that draws the game and talks to the engine
(librenethack_gd / renethack_gd.dll), the game's scene and its art pack
(renethack.pck). Copyright 2026 Vitaliy Velikodniy.

It holds texts of NetHack (the English catalog of what the engine says, the
Guidebook in the help), translations of them, and the names in
i18n-CREDITS.md; those parts are under the NetHack General Public License.

NetHack: the game engine
------------------------
engine/ (nh-engine, recover, data/) is NetHack 5.0.0 with renethack's
patches and protocol host:
  NetHack, Copyright 1985-2026 Stichting Mathematisch Centrum, M. Stephenson,
  the NetHack DevTeam and contributors.
It is under the NetHack General Public License,
NetHack-General-Public-License.txt. As its paragraph 3(a) asks, the complete
source code of these programs accompanies them: engine-source.tar.gz
(NetHack at the commit built, the patches, the host, the build files and the
Lua release it links; README.txt inside says how to build it).

Inside nh-engine:
  Lua 5.4, Copyright 1994-2025 Lua.org, PUC-Rio: MIT licence, Lua-LICENSE.txt.
  cJSON, Copyright 2009-2017 Dave Gamble and cJSON contributors: MIT
  licence, cJSON-LICENSE.txt.

Godot Engine
------------
The game's executable is Godot Engine's export template, Copyright Juan
Linietsky, Ariel Manzur and contributors: MIT licence, Godot-LICENSE.txt.
The third-party code inside Godot and its licences: Godot-COPYRIGHT.txt.

Rust crates
-----------
The extension is written in Rust and links the crates listed, with their
licences, in THIRD-PARTY-rust.txt. godot-rust (the crates godot, godot-core,
godot-ffi, godot-cell) is under the Mozilla Public License 2.0; its source is
at https://github.com/godot-rust/gdext (version as listed).

Art, fonts and texts
--------------------
art-CREDITS.md: the models, textures and effects. Most are CC0 (public
domain); the models under ccby/ are under Creative Commons Attribution 3.0,
credited there.
fonts/: Alegreya Sans, Alegreya Sans SC, Cormorant SC and PT Mono, under the
SIL Open Font License 1.1 (one licence file per family).
help-CREDITS.md: the Guidebook in English and in Russian.
i18n-CREDITS.md: the sources of the Russian translation.

Steam
-----
A build for Steam also holds Valve's Steamworks API library (steam_api),
redistributed under the Steamworks SDK Access Agreement.
